en.summary: Fixes generator-side sizing for the external-memory scratchpad writer path so its packetization width and maximum request size match that DMA path instead of incorrectly reusing the main DMA settings.
why_it_counts: The patch changes Scratchpad and configuration logic that determines the generated hardware parameters for an active DMA write path.
Using the wrong beat width and max-byte sizing changes how write masks and packet sizes are constructed inside StreamWriter, which is DUT behavior.
The commit message points to a concrete DMA assertion failure, and the fix changes the hardware generator rather than tests.
disqualifiers: The patch is configuration-heavy and includes debug print statements.
The observed failure is described through DMA assertions rather than a user-visible wrong final tensor, so the behavioral consequence is somewhat indirect.
evidence: GemminiArrayConfig gains dedicated spad_writer_dma_width and max_spad_writer_bytes fields.
Scratchpad instantiates spad_writer with those dedicated parameters instead of reusing dataBits and maxBytes from the main DMA path.
ConfigsFP.scala sets the MX FP configuration to a 512-bit spad-writer width and 64-byte limit.
StreamWriter derives mask and packet sizing from beatBits and maxBytes, so wrong inputs directly affect request construction.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This bug class appears when a design has more than one DMA write path but mistakenly reuses the packetization parameters of one path for another. If a secondary writer uses a different beat width or maximum transfer size than the main DMA engine, reusing the main-path constants causes its packet masks, burst-size selection, and byte accounting to be built for the wrong granularity. That commonly shows up as protocol assertions, malformed requests, or mis-sized transfers on the affected memory-write path.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: secondary DMA writer packet sizing and beat-width configuration
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A dedicated store path writes through a bus or memory port whose transfer granularity differs from the main DMA reader/writer configuration.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Configure the secondary write packetizer to reuse the main DMA beat width and max-request-size constants instead of the constants that match the secondary path.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse wrong DMA width and request-size parameters for a distinct write engine
portability_notes: This applies to RTL and generators alike; the bug can be injected either by miswiring parameters or by hardcoding the wrong constants in the write packetizer.
The affected path is usually a side writer for scratchpad spill, moveout, or storeback rather than the primary load/store DMA engine.
If your DUT has no explicit secondary DMA engine, inject the bug into any write path whose bus width differs from the global default packetizer settings.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the write engine that emits packets for a secondary memory path and determine its actual beat width and maximum legal request size.
Replace those path-specific constants with the beat width and max-bytes settings used by another DMA path that has different transfer granularity.
Leave the downstream bus interface unchanged so the mismatch surfaces in mask generation, burst sizing, or protocol assertions when the path is exercised.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad spad_writer StreamWriter instantiation and associated MX FP configuration sizing
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces dedicated spad_writer DMA sizing parameters, uses them when constructing the spad_writer StreamWriter, and sets the relevant MX FP config values so the external-memory writer is packetized for its real width.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In Scratchpad, instantiate spad_writer with dataBits and maxBytes again instead of spad_writer_dma_width and max_spad_writer_bytes, and remove or override the path-specific config values that were added for the MX FP configuration.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The secondary write path emits requests with the wrong beat grouping or byte count, typically causing DMA assertions, illegal masks, truncated writes, or malformed moveout/storeback transactions.
evidence_for_injection: StreamWriter computes maxBeatsPerReq, mask shape, and packet size directly from beatBits and maxBytes.
Before the fix, spad_writer inherited the main dataBits/maxBytes pair instead of path-specific sizing.
The fix adds dedicated config parameters rather than merely changing a test, indicating the generated hardware path itself was misconfigured.
The commit also forces a 64-byte memory width in Controller for the relevant shared-memory organization, consistent with a real datapath sizing mismatch.
notes: This is a generator/configuration-heavy DUT bugfix, so confidence is lower than for a direct datapath logic flip.
For reinjection, the Scratchpad spad_writer constructor arguments are the smallest source-level mutation that recreates the bug mechanism.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了外部内存 scratchpad writer 通路的生成参数尺寸错误，使其 packetization 宽度和最大请求大小与该 DMA 通路本身匹配，而不是错误复用主 DMA 的设置。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 Scratchpad 和配置逻辑，这些逻辑决定了一个实际 DMA 写路径的生成硬件参数。
错误的 beat width 和 max-byte 设置会改变 StreamWriter 内部写掩码和 packet 大小的构造方式，属于 DUT 行为。
提交信息指向具体的 DMA assertion 故障，而且修复修改的是硬件生成器而不是测试。
disqualifiers: 该补丁配置色彩较重，而且还带有调试打印语句。
可观察到的故障主要通过 DMA assertion 描述，而不是直接表现为最终张量错误，因此行为后果相对间接。
evidence: GemminiArrayConfig 新增了专用的 spad_writer_dma_width 和 max_spad_writer_bytes 字段。
Scratchpad 在实例化 spad_writer 时使用这些专用参数，而不再复用主 DMA 通路的 dataBits 和 maxBytes。
ConfigsFP.scala 把 MX FP 配置下的 spad-writer 宽度设置为 512 位、最大长度设置为 64 字节。
StreamWriter 的 mask 和 packet 尺寸直接由 beatBits 和 maxBytes 推导，因此错误输入会直接影响请求构造。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个设计里存在不止一条 DMA 写通路，却把其中一条通路的 packetization 参数错误复用到另一条通路时，就会出现这类错误。如果次级 writer 的 beat 宽度或最大传输大小与主 DMA 引擎不同，继续复用主通路常量会让它的 packet mask、burst 大小选择和字节计数全部按错误粒度生成。典型后果就是协议断言触发、请求格式错误，或者在该写通路上出现长度不对的传输。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 次级 DMA writer 的 packet 尺寸与 beat 宽度配置
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某条专用 store 通路通过一个与主 DMA reader/writer 配置粒度不同的总线或内存端口写数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让次级写 packetizer 重新复用主 DMA 的 beat width 和最大请求大小常量，而不是使用与该次级通路匹配的专用常量。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 对独立写引擎复用错误的 DMA 宽度和请求大小参数
portability_notes: 这既可用于 RTL，也可用于生成器；可以通过错连参数或在写 packetizer 中硬编码错误常量来注入。
受影响的路径通常是 scratchpad spill、moveout 或 storeback 之类的侧路 writer，而不是主 load/store DMA 引擎。
如果你的 DUT 没有显式的次级 DMA 引擎，就把该错误注入到任一总线宽度不同于全局默认 packetizer 设置的写路径上。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位负责次级内存写通路发包的写引擎，并确认它真实的 beat 宽度和最大合法请求大小。
把这些路径专属常量替换成另一条 DMA 通路的 beat width 和 max-bytes 设置，且两者传输粒度必须不同。
保持下游总线接口不变，使这种不匹配在路径被触发时以 mask 生成错误、burst 尺寸错误或协议断言的形式暴露出来。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad 中 spad_writer 的 StreamWriter 实例化及其相关 MX FP 配置尺寸参数
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了专用的 spad_writer DMA 尺寸参数，在构造 spad_writer 的 StreamWriter 时使用这些参数，并设置相关 MX FP 配置值，使外部内存 writer 以其真实宽度进行 packetization。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 Scratchpad 中，把 spad_writer 的构造参数重新改回 dataBits 和 maxBytes，而不是 spad_writer_dma_width 和 max_spad_writer_bytes；同时删除或覆盖为 MX FP 配置新增的路径专属参数值。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 次级写通路会发出 beat 分组或字节计数错误的请求，通常表现为 DMA assertion、非法 mask、写入被截断，或 moveout/storeback 事务格式错误。
evidence_for_injection: StreamWriter 会直接根据 beatBits 和 maxBytes 计算 maxBeatsPerReq、mask 形状和 packet 大小。
修复前，spad_writer 继承的是主通路的 dataBits/maxBytes，而不是该路径自己的尺寸参数。
修复通过新增专用配置参数完成，而不是修改测试，这说明是生成硬件路径本身配置错误。
同一提交还把 Controller 里的相关共享内存宽度固定到 64 字节，进一步表明这是真实的数据通路尺寸不匹配。
notes: 这是一个偏生成器/配置层面的 DUT bugfix，因此置信度低于直接的数据通路逻辑翻转。
对于回注入，最小的源码级变异就是回退 Scratchpad 中 spad_writer 的构造参数。
